plugin.name: Checking your setup
plugin.description: Rapport.esp: found. Rapport plays every scene Chemistry picks; Chemistry needs Rapport 0.2.1 or newer, and Servitrons need 0.2.19 or newer. AAF.esm: found. Advanced Animation Framework plays the scenes for Rapport. F4SE: check this yourself. Rapport is an F4SE plugin: start the game through f4se_loader.exe (f4se.silverlock.org). MCM: check this yourself. Optional: Mod Configuration Menu gives Chemistry its settings page and hotkeys; without it everything runs on its defaults. Install Chemistry after Rapport, with Vortex or MO2. Manual installs are not supported.

plugin.name: NPCs find each other
plugin.description: In vanilla Fallout 4, NPCs never get together on their own. About every 30 seconds Chemistry weighs the pairs nearby and, now and then, picks one for a scene; Rapport plays it. Most of the time the answer is no: scenes are rare on purpose, and each person rests a day after one.

plugin.name: Couples, not coincidences
plugin.description: People who already know each other, such as spouses, family, friends and co-workers, are far likelier to get together, and every scene they share brings them closer. A married couple starts close before their first scene.

plugin.name: Their own place
plugin.description: A pair indoors in one of their own homes, or in their faction's building, is much likelier to get together, and at home it is unhurried, whoever walks through.

plugin.name: Personalities and faithfulness
plugin.description: Two of a kind get on; the romantic one and the crude one clash; the crude one likes an audience and the shy one hates one. Married NPCs mostly stay true, each by their own nature, and a stray is remembered as an affair. Your lover from Overture counts as taken.

plugin.name: The right kind of scene
plugin.description: The place and the crowd pick which of Rapport's scenes it is: a long one at home, a slow one somewhere quiet, a quick one with people around. When nothing happens, Rapport's Narrator can tell you who nearly did and why.

plugin.name: Servitrons are always willing
plugin.description: With Anatomy Servitron and Rapport 0.2.19 or newer, Servitrons join everyday life. Nothing in Chemistry holds one back: not her own faithfulness, a clash of personalities or shyness. Her partner still has their own reasons, and their orientation applies to the body she wears.
